text:
Sam (People Ops): Heads-up: launching a 6-month PTO Donation Pilot starting today. Goal: let teammates donate unused PTO to colleagues facing unexpected personal crises (medical, family emergency). Pilot details below and how to participate.

Lina: This is awesome  is it anonymous?

Sam (People Ops): Donor identities are hidden from recipients by default (opt-in reveal allowed). We log donation amounts to payroll for record-keeping but recipients only see total hours received.

Omar: How much can someone donate or receive?

Sam (People Ops): Donate up to 40 hours/year. Individuals may receive up to 160 hours from the donation pool per qualifying event, subject to review.

Anjali (Finance): Tax/comp rules: donated time is treated as PTO transfer, not additional income. We will confirm year-end reporting implications for local jurisdictions; donors do not get cash value back.

Tara (People Ops): Eligibility: recipient must have an approved hardship request (medical, caregiving, disaster). Managers or People Ops can submit a hardship nomination; self-submissions allowed with supporting docs.

Lina: Approval cadence? Need something same-day sometimes.

Sam (People Ops): Manager approval + People Ops sign-off. For urgent cases, we have a 48-hour expedited review track; donations can be applied retroactively.

Omar: What about PTO accruals and balances after donating?

Anjali (Finance): Donors reduce their available balance immediately when donation is processed. Accrual rate unaffected. Payroll will show a separate line item for donated hours.

Lina: Will this affect bereavement or disability leave buckets?

Tara (People Ops): No changes to statutory or short-term disability or bereavement policy. Donation pool applies only to standard PTO balances.

Sam (People Ops): Important: this is voluntary. Were tracking uptake, time-to-approve, demographic spread, and manager burden. Pilot closes in 6 months, after which well evaluate making it permanent or adjusting parameters.

Lina: How do I donate?

Sam (People Ops): People Portal -> Time Off -> Donate PTO. You can schedule a one-off donation or set a recurring donation (quarterly). Link: https://people.redwood.example.com/donate-pto (internal).

Omar: Can managers earmark donations for a specific person?

Tara (People Ops): You can target a named recipient (if they consent) or donate to the general hardship pool. Targeted donations require manager approval on both sides.

Anjali (Finance): Tracking note for managers: donated hours are final once processed. No reversals except in documented error cases.

Lina: Will donors get any recognition? Badges?

Sam (People Ops): Well surface opt-in recognition in the internal profile (only if the donor opts in). No monetary or extra PTO reward.

Omar: Travel-related question  are there any travel policy changes tied to this pilot?

Sam (People Ops): Not directly, but two travel updates today: 1) small attestation added to the travel booking flow reminding travelers to follow the Code of Conduct and local laws; 2) Travel-Bot will now send a safety & documentation checklist 48 hours before international trips.

Travel-Bot: Travel attestation added to booking flow. Safety checklist scheduled for 48h before departure for international itineraries.

Tara (People Ops): We also added a one-question pre-trip check for high-risk locations (country list maintained by Security). If youre flagged, travel needs manager + Security sign-off.

Omar: Any change to per-diem or caps?

Anjali (Finance): No cap changes in this pilot announcement. Existing travel reimbursement rules remain; exceptions still require a Travel Exception form and Finance approval.

Lina: Will there be a FAQ or training for managers?

Sam (People Ops): Yes  one-pager + manager office hours next Wednesday 11am PT. Ill post the one-pager in #people-ops and email people leads by EOD.

Anjali (Finance): Small payroll note: donations processed before payroll close for the month will reflect in that months report. Please coordinate with your manager if timing is sensitive.

Tara (People Ops): Feedback welcome during the pilot. Please DM me or use the anonymous form here: https://forms.redwood.example.com/pto-donation-feedback

Sam (People Ops): Final: full pilot policy & request flow is live at /policies/time-off/pto-donation-pilot (internal). Town-hall on Friday at 9am PT for a 20-min walk-through and Q&A. Thanks everyone. :heart:
